_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: New: EWUdiots Club (More → EWUdiots Club): every EWU club, news, events and sign-ups
Club members get a members-only space: announcements, attendance, polls, tasks and documents
Club organisers: registration forms with a responses dashboard, QR tickets and CSV export
Club admins invite members by student ID; they join automatically when they open Clubs
Certificates from clubs that anyone can check
Sign-up, teacher email, Analytics and scanner fixes from 2.12.1
